drezus.bio: Saskatoon-born Indigenous rapper Drezus, from Muskowekwan and Cote First Nations, combines Anishinaabe and Nehiyaw teachings with hip-hop, storytelling and community-rooted expression.

dvsn.bio: Toronto R&B duo dvsn pairs vocalist Daniel Daley with producer Nineteen85, balancing falsetto-led songwriting with atmospheric, contemporary production.

dylan sinclair.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Dylan Sinclair makes contemporary R&B built around restrained production, intimate writing and a poised vocal style that earned his debut album Proverb a Juno nomination.

emma beko.bio: Montréal artist Emma Beko blends abstract hip-hop, grunge and emotionally raw songwriting, drawing on a multicultural upbringing and years in the duo Heartstreets.

everythingoshaun.bio: Brampton-based recording artist EverythingOShauN, also known as Joseph Njoku, makes genre-fluid hip-hop and has placed his music in major television series while building an independent Canadian catalogue.

eva avila.bio: Gatineau singer-songwriter and actor Eva Avila rose nationally after winning Canadian Idol in 2006 and went on to release two albums with Sony BMG.

eva shaw.bio: Toronto-born Canadian DJ, songwriter and producer Eva Shaw works across electronic music and hip-hop, building a catalogue that spans club records, production and artist collaborations.

evil ebenezer.bio: Vancouver-based rapper and singer Evil Ebenezer is a longtime Western Canadian hip-hop artist known for darkly comic writing, extensive touring and a prolific independent catalogue.

faber drive.bio: Mission, British Columbia band Faber Drive built a Canadian pop-rock and pop-punk catalogue around melodic hooks, radio-ready songwriting and energetic live performances.

fefe dobson.bio: Scarborough-born singer-songwriter Fefe Dobson is a Canadian pop-rock and pop-punk trailblazer whose early-2000s catalogue helped broaden representation in guitar-driven mainstream pop.

felix cartal.bio: Vancouver producer and DJ Felix Cartal makes melodic electronic and house music, pairing club-focused production with pop songwriting and collaborations across Canada's music scene.

finger eleven.bio: Burlington, Ontario rock band Finger Eleven evolved from its early Rainbow Butt Monkeys incarnation into a long-running alternative-rock act with platinum-selling records in Canada and the United States.
